description: React component for a toolbar in a Kanban board application. Provides controls for adding columns, exporting data, CSV import/export, toggling views, and fullscreen mode. Includes modal dialogs for user interactions such as bulk uploading via Excel, CSV sync, and adding columns.

methods.name: downloadExcelTemplate()
methods.description: Generates and downloads an Excel template with predefined columns for task import.

methods.name: handleAddColumn
methods.description: Opens the modal to add a new column.

methods.name: handleAddColumnSubmit
methods.description: Handles submission of the new column form and adds a new column to the kanban board.

methods.name: handleExcelUpload
methods.description: Reads uploaded Excel file, parses sheet data, and shows modal for column selection.

methods.name: handleConfirmBulkUpload
methods.description: Processes bulk card data from Excel, maps rows to card objects, and inserts into the board.

methods.name: handleExportCardsCsv
methods.description: Exports current cards to CSV and triggers download.

methods.name: handleCsvFileSelected
methods.description: Reads selected CSV file, previews structure, and prompts for sync.

methods.name: handleConfirmCsvSync
methods.description: Performs CSV sync, updating existing cards and inserting new ones.

methods.name: Toolbar({ onToggleFullscreen, isFullscreen, crOnly, onToggleCrOnly, canEdit = true })

ctags.name: Toolbar
ctags.pattern: /^function Toolbar({ onToggleFullscreen, isFullscreen, crOnly, onToggleCrOnly, canEdit = true }) {$/
ctags.signature: ({ onToggleFullscreen, isFullscreen, crOnly, onToggleCrOnly, canEdit = true })
